title: Unique normalized unbounded derived boundary
statement: Let C be Grothendieck abelian and D abelian, both with derived categories. Let S be a short complex of additive functors C to D that is short exact on injective objects. There exists a unique natural transformation R(S_3) to R(S_1)[1] whose value on every termwise injective K-injective complex is the canonical boundary of its degreewise short exact complex, under the standard computation isomorphisms of right derived functors. The categories and right derived functors are those of [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] and [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories].

proof.text: Use [lem-pur-unbounded-injective-model] to choose a termwise injective K-injective model of each derived object. Conjugate the canonical short exact complex boundary of [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle] by the right-derived computation isomorphisms.

The K-injective Hom bijection [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived] represents a derived morphism by a chain map into the chosen model. Naturality of short exact complex boundaries, as implemented in rightDerivedδAux_naturality, proves naturality and independence of models. Compare the chosen model of Q(I) to the identity model to obtain the required normalization.

For two normalized transformations, cancel the shifted computation isomorphism to show equality on Q(I) for each model. Naturality along Q(I) isomorphic to M and cancellation of the induced isomorphism prove equality on every M.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_unique_unboundedDerivedBoundary
    {C : Type u} {D : Type u'} [Category.{v} C] [Category.{v'} D]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v} C]
    [HasDerivedCategory C] [HasDerivedCategory D]
    (S : ShortComplex (C ⥤ D)) [S.X₁.Additive] [S.X₂.Additive] [S.X₃.Additive]
    (hS : S.ShortExactOnInjectives) :
    ∃! δ : S.X₃.rightDerivedFunctor ⟶
        S.X₁.rightDerivedFunctor ⋙ shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory D) (1 : ℤ),
      ∀ (I : CochainComplex C ℤ) [I.IsKInjective] [∀ n : ℤ, Injective (I.X n)],
        δ.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I) ≫
            (S.X₁.rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso I).hom⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' =
          (S.X₃.rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso I).hom ≫
            DerivedCategory.triangleOfSESδ (hS.shortExact_mapCochainComplex I)
